question: Which is an uricosuric drug-
analysis: Uricosuric drugs are medications that increase the excretion of uric acid in the urine. Among the options provided, Probenecid is the only drug that functions as a uricosuric agent, helping to lower uric acid levels in conditions like gout. Allopurinol is a xanthine oxidase inhibitor, Indomethacin is a nonsteroidal anti-inflammatory drug (NSAID), and Aspirin can actually decrease uric acid excretion at low doses.
